ALTER VIEW [DW].[DimAccount_IBG_View]
AS
WITH DIM_ACCOUNT_1 as ( SELECT AccountSK
	,AccountID
	,AccountName
	,AccountOpenedDate
	,AccountStatus
	,PayrollIndicator
	,CurrencyCode
	,CASE 
		WHEN ISNUMERIC(ProfitCostCode) = 0
			OR ProfitCostCode = ''
			OR ProfitCostCode LIKE '-%'
			THEN ''
		ELSE CONVERT(INT, ProfitCostCode)
		END AS ProfitCostCode
	,BankSK
	,BranchSK
	,SourceSystemCode
	,CurrentIndicator
	,ValidStartDate
	,ValidEndDate
	,WorkFlowId
	,TaskRunId
	,InsertDttm
FROM DW.DimAccount
WHERE CurrentIndicator = 1
	AND SourceSystemCode IN (
		'DEP'
		,'LNS'
		)
)

select * from DIM_ACCOUNT_1 DA
where DA.profitcostcode between 2000 and 2740;
